recipes.name: Korean-style collard greens side dish
instructions: Boil water in a large pot.
Cut off the top tough part of the collard greens, and arrange the leaves side by side, stems and leaves.
Add a handful of salt to the boiling water.
Put the collard greens stem-first in boiling water and cook for 1 minute. Submerge them in the water by pressing them down with a wooden spoon.
Close the lid and cook for 3 minutes.
Drain the collard greens and rinse them in cold water a couple of times.
Drain the water and chop the leaves into small pieces.
Put them in a wok or cooking pot.
Blend the roasted cashew nuts with the water in a blender for a minute. Add it to the pot.
Add the minced garlic, kosher salt, olive oil, honey and vinegar. Mix it well with a spoon and bring to a boil over high heat.
10 minutes later, open the lid and mix it with a spoon and cook another 10 minutes.
Transfer it to a serving plate and serve with rice or a meat dish such as roasted meat or BBQ.
